name: Hoosier Custom Plastics
old_description: Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC Specializes in Tight Tolerance Plastic Insert Molding and Plastic Injection Molding
about:
Hoosier Custom Plastics operates from Knox, Indiana, and was founded in 2004 as a privately held manufacturer specializing in plastic molding. The company focuses on tight-tolerance plastic insert molding and injection molding, including over molding and insert molding with aluminum inserts, plastic fasteners, threaded brass, and knurled inserts. It also provides value-added light assembly services such as sonic welding, plastic joining, O-ring installation, and manual box-build assembly. Biopolymer molding is offered for environmentally friendly applications. The facility handles production volumes ranging from a few thousand pieces per year to several million.

Hoosier Custom Plastics serves the automotive, aerospace and defense (NADCAP accredited), electrical and electronics, appliance, and consumer goods sectors. Molded components include transmission and interior parts for vehicles, caster wheels, sealing systems, golf tees, food-handling and gardening products, and washer, dryer, and dishwasher components.

The company states its differentiation as delivering world-class quality and delivery performance with competitive pricing across all volume requirements.
